Changes: anchor semantic = first provider-accepted (sent_at) notice per the Reply-lane port (veto-window-gate.ts:84); downgrade-reason vocabulary made B14/B15-consistent; surface gains worker/ingress/resend.ts (+tests); tests_to_add expanded 19 -> 44 titles from the review's missing-failing-test list.
goal: Ship the Auto-approval lane (#631): an Autopilot-tier batch auto-approves as approval_method='auto_policy' at the ask-generation finale behind SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED, with the D9 60-minute veto window anchored on the first provider-accepted Veto notice, fail-closed.
non_goals: Per-ask Judge verdicts — spec: '#631 must not grow a verdict path' (§9.4 deferred)
Staging/prod flag flips and flip evidence — #633 owns the flips; #631 lands inert (flag unset everywhere)
Changing BATCH_CAP=25 or making it owner-adjustable (D20: asymmetric by design)
Retroactive auto-approval of batches built before the flag flip — decision runs at the generation finale only
New analytics events — matches #629 precedent; observability is spine + release report + Sentry
One-click halt token links — the Veto notice links to /dashboard/requests, login required
Requests-panel copy changes for the auto lane — follow-up if review demands it
user_visible_behavior: A batch whose generation finale finds SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED + SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED, tierGrantsAutopilot, a persona='solicitation' policy row, and no Governor suspension on any account policy row is approved as auto_policy inside the finale transaction; the owner sees it approved, never pending review. An owner approval that raced ahead wins quietly.

The owner receives a Veto notice on enrolled channels; the veto window (30/60 min per policy, default 60) starts at the FIRST provider-accepted send (sent_at — the Reply-lane anchor semantic), not at approval
The owner can halt the batch (owner_veto) during the veto window on the existing Requests surface; admins via the admin surface

The releaser re-checks the auto conditions for unreleased auto_policy batches each tick; auto flag off, Autopilot tier lost, policy row gone, or suspension latched ⇒ downgradeApproval to owner review with the exact reason (auto_approval_disabled | autopilot_entitlement_lost | policy_removed | policy_suspended). A subscription lapse HOLDS (B14, existing withhold) and the master send flag off STOPS the phase (B15) — neither ever downgrades.

/settings/auto-approval gains a Solicitation section: opt-in toggle (creates/removes the persona='solicitation' account-default row via a new operation in the existing discriminated-union PATCH contract), daily_send_cap dial (1..50), veto window dial (30 or 60, default 60) — API-driven state, both server flags gate visibility
invariants: Invariant #3 analog (spec §Invariants table): no email leaves without approval_method IN ('owner','auto_policy'); the auto lane additionally requires tier + both flags + Judge availability + the anchored veto window

D9 fail-closed, ported exactly from the Reply lane's SHIPPED discipline (veto-window-gate.ts anchors on MIN(sent_at)): no provider-accepted Veto notice ⇒ veto_deadline_at stays NULL ⇒ the releaser never releases; the batch terminalizes by the existing expiry closure — never a silent send

veto_deadline_at is written ONCE via CAS (WHERE veto_deadline_at IS NULL) computed IN SQL from MIN(notification_deliveries.sent_at), and never recomputed; the grant is recorded as an append-only veto_window_granted spine step
The granted window is read from the policy row AT approval and recorded in the batch_approved spine step; the anchor reads it back from that step — later policy edits never move an in-flight window
Four-condition opt-in (D20): absence of the persona='solicitation' policy row = auto lane off; rows written only through server routes (invariant #14)

Governor account-wide read: an active suspension on ANY auto_approval_policies row for the account blocks auto-approval (D19); the approval-time read is serialized with settings/Governor writers via the documented batch-then-account lock order (src/lib/auto-approval/account-lock.ts)
Invariant #2: the veto-notice enqueue rides the approving transaction via job_outbox; the new topic gets a typed helper
Invariant #11: entitlement via subscriptionGrantsFullAccess, never a raw status compare; trialing + Autopilot has full access
Judge availability stays a DISPATCH precondition owned by the releaser (#900 applyJudgeSplit); no approval-time Judge check
The veto-notice worker gates on BATCH STATE only (auto_policy, not halted/closed) — no flag reads; transparency fails open while sends fail closed
edge_cases: Owner approval commits between the last child render and the finale ⇒ the auto CAS matches zero rows ⇒ quiet owner_won outcome, never a throw/retry loop
All notice channels fail or none are enrolled ⇒ no anchor, batch expires via existing closure; systemic-failure log on BOTH the dispatch zero-sent path and the worker zero-enrolled early return
Judge down at the first release tick ⇒ existing applyJudgeSplit downgrades the auto batch — accepted churn, no approval-time duplication

One-active-send-batch index rejects the auto approval (23505 on solicitation_batches_one_active_send_per_business, caught OUTSIDE the savepoint callback) ⇒ batch stays built for owner review; any other 23505 rethrows
Owner halts during the veto window, a notice send lands later ⇒ the anchor CAS must not resurrect a halted batch
Duplicate sends/retries ⇒ claim rows dedup per channel; the anchor CAS is idempotent; the first sent_at wins
Flag flips ON with built batches already waiting ⇒ no retroactive sweep

Policy row deleted between approval and release ⇒ release-time re-check downgrades (policy_removed); the re-check re-reads conditions inside the downgrade transaction under the batch+account locks, AND the row-release transaction re-reads them again for auto_policy batches (account lock, in-tx) so a deletion or suspension committed after a passing arm-level check still releases nothing
Subscription lapses after auto approval ⇒ the batch HOLDS via the existing release-phase subscription withhold and resumes on recovery (B14) — no downgrade, no reason written
Master send flag off ⇒ release phase stops (flag_off, B15); queued Veto notices still dispatch (batch-state gating only)
Telegram-only owner ⇒ anchors normally via sent_at (Telegram has no delivery receipt; the Reply lane shipped the same answer)
Hard-bounced owner email on the veto template ⇒ resend ingress marks owner_email_bounced (OWNER_DIRECTED_TEMPLATES registration) so later notices skip the dead address

rollback_plan: Flag SOLICITATION_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED ships unset (default OFF) in every environment, so the lane lands inert. Back-out order if flipped: (1) unset the flag — the approval-time gate refuses new auto approvals and the release-time gate downgrades unreleased auto_policy batches to owner review; (2) migration 113 is index-only (outbox in-flight index + notification_deliveries claim index) — down = DROP INDEX both, no data movement; (3) code revert is a clean git revert (no columns added). Staging first, prod in lockstep per deployment-guide.
